faq.q: What is this page — a neighbourhood guide or an index?
faq.a: An index. The page, headed "The three Cloverdale areas," links one guide for each Cloverdale MLS® area — Cloverdale BC, Clayton and Serpentine — each covering schools, parks, planning and what to check before buying, and it carries no single-neighbourhood profile of its own.

faq.q: Which schools serve the Cloverdale areas?
faq.a: Schools confirmed by name and address against the BC Ministry K-12 file include Cloverdale Traditional, A J McLellan, George Greenaway, Don Christian, Martha Currie, Sunrise Ridge, Katzie, Hazelgrove and Regent Road elementaries, and Lord Tweedsmuir, Clayton Heights and École Salish secondaries — but SD36 catchments are address-based, so check the exact address in the district's School Locator (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: Who can help me buy or sell in Cloverdale?
faq.a: Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, works across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361 or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Cloverdale?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.
